r_chicken_garlic_butter.title: Garlic-butter chicken + rice
r_chicken_garlic_butter.subtitle: Chicken group
steps: Cook the rice: 1 cup rice + 2 cups water + a pinch of salt, cover on low heat ~15 min.
In a pan, melt the butter with a spoon of oil over medium heat.
Toss in the garlic, stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chicken cubes, season with salt and pepper, stir until golden (~8 min).
Serve over the rice. Done! 🍽️
r_chicken_garlic_butter.tip: Don't move the chicken too much at first — let one side brown before flipping so it gets a nice color.

r_chicken_oven_potato.title: Oven chicken with potatoes
r_chicken_oven_potato.subtitle: One tray
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Lay the chicken, potatoes, and onion on a tray.
Drizzle the oil and all the spices, and rub it onto every piece.
Bake ~30 min until the potatoes are soft and the chicken is golden.
Done — easiest dinner ever! 🎉
r_chicken_oven_potato.tip: Cut the potatoes small so they cook as fast as the chicken.

r_chicken_quick_pepper.title: Quick pepper chicken
r_chicken_quick_pepper.subtitle: Fast wok
steps: Heat the oil over high heat in a pan.
Add the chicken, stir fast ~5 min until it turns white.
Throw in the peppers, onion, and garlic, stir ~3 min.
Add the soy sauce, one last stir, and take it off.
Eat it on its own or with rice. ⚡
r_chicken_quick_pepper.tip: The heat has to be high — that's the secret to a fast stir-fry, and the veg stays crisp.

r_chicken_lemon_broccoli.title: Lemon-broccoli chicken
r_chicken_lemon_broccoli.subtitle: Healthy & light
steps: Boil the broccoli in salted water ~4 min, then drain.
In a pan, oil + garlic, add the chicken until cooked (~8 min).
Add the broccoli, season with salt, pepper, and the lemon juice.
Stir a minute and take it off.
Light, healthy, and tasty. 🥦
r_chicken_lemon_broccoli.tip: Don't overcook the broccoli — once it's bright green and slightly tender, pull it out.

r_chicken_mushroom.title: Creamy mushroom chicken
r_chicken_mushroom.subtitle: Light & creamy
steps: In a pan, butter + onion, stir until soft.
Add the chicken until cooked (~7 min).
Add the mushrooms, stir until the water dries up (~5 min).
Season with salt, pepper, and a little milk if you want it creamy.
Serve with rice or bread. 🍄
r_chicken_mushroom.tip: Mushrooms release water — keep the heat high until it evaporates and they turn golden.

r_chicken_grilled_salad.title: Marinated grilled chicken + salad
r_chicken_grilled_salad.subtitle: Healthy
ingredients: 1 spoon olive oil for the salad
steps: Marinate the chicken: oil + lemon + spices, rub it in and leave 10 min.
Grill it in a non-stick pan over medium heat ~6 min per side.
Chop the cucumber and tomato, dress with salt, olive oil, and lemon.
Serve the chicken next to the salad.
A restaurant meal at home! 🥗
r_chicken_grilled_salad.tip: Make sure the chicken's cooked — cut it in the middle, it should be white not pink.

r_salmon_oven_lemon.title: Lemon oven salmon
r_salmon_oven_lemon.subtitle: The easiest
ingredients: A frozen salmon fillet (thaw in the fridge overnight)
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Put the salmon on a small tray over baking paper.
Brush it with oil, season with salt, pepper, and garlic, and lay the lemon slices on top.
Bake ~15 min.
Done — the fish flakes easily now. 🐟
r_salmon_oven_lemon.tip: Thaw the salmon in the fridge the night before — don't thaw it in hot water.

r_salmon_pan_veg.title: Pan salmon + sautéed veg
r_salmon_pan_veg.subtitle: In the pan
steps: Pat the salmon dry with a paper towel (important!).
Heat oil in a pan, put the salmon skin-side down, ~4 min without moving it.
Flip ~3 min on the other side, then take it out.
In the same pan, toss the veg and garlic, stir ~4 min with salt and pepper.
Set the salmon on top of the veg. 🍳
r_salmon_pan_veg.tip: Drying the salmon before frying is the secret to a crispy crust — don't skip it.

r_salmon_honey_soy.title: Honey-soy salmon + rice
r_salmon_honey_soy.subtitle: Asian flavor
steps: Cook the rice (1 cup rice + 2 cups water + salt, 15 min).
Mix the honey + soy + garlic in a bowl.
Fry the salmon in a pan with oil ~4 min per side.
Pour the honey mix over it, let it bubble a minute until glossy.
Serve over the rice. 🍚
r_salmon_honey_soy.tip: Watch the honey — it burns fast, so add it in the last minute over low heat.

r_salmon_oven_veg.title: Oven salmon + roasted veg
r_salmon_oven_veg.subtitle: One tray
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Put the veg on a tray, oil and spices, and roast 15 min first.
Pull out the tray, set the salmon in the middle, drizzle oil, salt, and lemon.
Back in the oven ~12 min.
Everything on one tray — less cleanup! ✨
r_salmon_oven_veg.tip: The veg needs longer than the fish, that's why we start it first.

r_kofta_rice.title: Beef kofta + rice
r_kofta_rice.subtitle: Classic
steps: Cook the rice (1 cup rice + 2 cups water + salt).
Knead the beef with the onion and spices well.
Shape it into fingers or patties.
Grill in a pan with a little oil ~5 min per side until cooked.
Serve with the rice. 🍚
r_kofta_rice.tip: Don't flip the kofta too soon — let it set on one side first so it doesn't break apart.

r_mince_potato.title: Ground beef with potatoes
r_mince_potato.subtitle: One dish
steps: Fry the cubed potatoes in a little oil until cooked, then take them out.
In the same pan, add the onion and garlic until soft.
Add the beef, break it up and stir until it changes color.
Add the tomato paste, spices, and a little water, simmer 5 min.
Return the potatoes, stir, and it's ready. 🥔
r_mince_potato.tip: Ground beef cooks fast — the moment the pink is gone, it's ready.

r_burger_salad.title: Beef burger + salad
r_burger_salad.subtitle: Weekend
steps: Season the beef with salt, pepper, and garlic, knead it and form a patty.
Press the patty thin with your hand (it puffs up while cooking).
Grill in a hot pan ~4 min per side.
Prep the salad next to it, or put it in the bun.
Healthy homemade burger! 🍔
r_burger_salad.tip: Don't press the burger with a fork while it cooks — you'll squeeze out the juices and dry it out.

r_menemen.title: Menemen (eggs with tomato & pepper)
r_menemen.subtitle: Turkish breakfast
steps: Heat the oil in a pan, add the pepper until soft.
Add the tomato, let it cook ~4 min until tender.
Crack the eggs on top, season with salt and pepper.
Stir gently until the eggs just set but stay soft.
Eat it with bread — top breakfast! 🍞
r_menemen.tip: Low heat at the last step so the eggs stay soft, not dry.

r_oats_banana.title: Oats with milk + banana
r_oats_banana.subtitle: 5-minute breakfast
steps: Put the oats and milk in a bowl.
Heat 2 min in the microwave, or 3 min on the stove while you stir.
Top with the banana, honey, and a pinch of cinnamon.
Quick, filling, and full of energy. 🍌
r_oats_banana.tip: Short on time in the morning? Soak the oats in milk overnight in the fridge and eat them cold.

r_omelette_veg_cheese.title: Veggie & cheese omelette
r_omelette_veg_cheese.subtitle: Protein
steps: Whisk the eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a pan, add the veg and stir a minute.
Pour the eggs over, let them spread out.
When they start to set, add the cheese in the middle and fold the omelette in half.
A protein-packed breakfast. 🧀
r_omelette_veg_cheese.tip: Medium heat, and don't wait for the eggs to fully set — fold while still slightly soft.

r_boiled_eggs.title: Boiled eggs + cheese + veg
r_boiled_eggs.subtitle: Simplest breakfast
steps: Put the eggs in a pot of water, boil 8 min for firm eggs.
Cool them in cold water and peel.
Chop the cucumber and tomato.
Arrange on a plate with the cheese and bread.
A classic Turkish breakfast, zero effort. 🥚
r_boiled_eggs.tip: 7 min for a soft yolk, 10 min for fully set — pick whichever you like.
